q: A bakery sells muffins for $3 each, or in boxes of 4 for $10. What is the lowest cost, in dollars, of buying exactly 11 muffins?
A train travels 210 km at an average speed of 84 km/h. How many minutes does the journey take?
A shirt costs $80. Its price is cut by 25%, and then the reduced price is raised by 10%. What is the final price in dollars?
Three workers paint 3 fences in 3 hours, and every worker paints at the same steady rate. How many hours do 6 workers need to paint 12 fences?
The sum of three consecutive even integers is 138. What is the largest of the three?

One pipe fills an empty tank in 6 hours and a second pipe fills it in 9 hours. With both pipes running together, how many hours does it take to fill the empty tank? Give the answer as a decimal number.
Mia is 4 times as old as her son. In 20 years she will be twice as old as he will be then. How old is Mia now?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 54 cm, and its length is twice its width. What is its area in square centimetres?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the two numbers add up to 9? Give it as a fraction in lowest terms.
An account pays 10% interest once a year, added to the balance at the end of each year. You deposit $2,000 and withdraw nothing. How many dollars are in the account after 3 years?
Alice, Bob and Carol each own exactly one pet, and the pets are a cat, a dog and a fish. Alice does not own the dog. Bob owns the fish. Who owns the dog? Answer with the name only.
All bloops are razzies, and all razzies are lazzies. Must every bloop be a lazzie? Answer yes or no.
Five runners finish a race with no ties. Dan finished before Eve. Eve finished before Finn. Gail finished after Finn but before Hal. Who finished third? Answer with the name only.
On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says: "B is a knave." B says: "A and I are both knights." Is A a knight or a knave? Answer with one word.
A drawer holds 5 red, 7 blue and 9 green socks. In the dark, what is the smallest number of socks you must take out to be certain of having two of the same colour?
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ...?
A is taller than B. C is shorter than B. D is taller than A. Who is the second shortest of the four? Answer with the letter only.
In a class of 30 students, 18 play football, 12 play tennis, and 5 play both. How many students play neither sport?

A key is in exactly one of three boxes: red, blue or green. Exactly one of these statements is true: (1) The key is in the red box. (2) The key is not in the blue box. (3) The key is not in the red box. Which box holds the key? Answer with the colour only.

Pia, Quinn, Ray and Sam sit in a row of four seats numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Pia sits in seat 1. Quinn sits directly next to Pia. Ray does not sit next to Quinn. Who sits in seat 4? Answer with the name only.
Name three different colours of the rainbow. Reply with exactly three words, all lowercase, separated by single hyphens, with no spaces.
Write the word banana backwards in capital letters, and nothing else.
List the odd numbers from 1 to 7 in descending order, separated by commas with no spaces.
Write a sentence of exactly five words that ends with the word tonight. Use no punctuation at all.
Spell the word Wednesday in capital letters with a hyphen between each pair of letters, and nothing else.
Sort these words alphabetically and reply with them on one line, separated by single spaces: pear apple mango cherry banana
Reply with a JSON object on a single line with exactly two keys, in this order: "city" set to the string "Oslo", then "year" set to the number 2031.
Write the first four multiples of 9, starting with 9, in increasing order, each followed by a semicolon, all on one line with no spaces.
Reply with the word yes repeated exactly four times, in capital letters, separated by single spaces.
Take the first letter of each word in "Quiet Umbrellas Increase Every Tuesday" and reply with them joined into one lowercase word.
3 March 2025 was a Monday. What day of the week was 1 May 2025?
A 30-day pass starts on 31 January 2024, and that day counts as day 1. What date is day 30? Answer in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
A meeting starts at 22:45 and lasts 2 hours 50 minutes. At what time does it end? Answer in 24-hour HH:MM format.
1 January 2030 is a Tuesday. What day of the week is 1 January 2031?
How many days are there from 15 February 2028 to 15 March 2028, counting the first day but not the last?

A parcel is shipped on Friday 8 August 2025 and takes 5 business days to arrive. Business days are Monday to Friday, and the shipping day does not count. On what date does it arrive? Answer in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
It is 09:30 in a city at UTC+1. What time is it at that moment in a city at UTC+9? Answer in 24-hour HH:MM format.
Sam was born on 12 November 1998. How old was Sam, in whole years, on 11 November 2026?
What date is 100 days after 1 October 2026? Answer in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
A class meets every Tuesday, every week. The first class was on Tuesday 6 January 2026. On what date is the 10th class? Answer in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
